{{Wireless adapter |brand=Samsung |model=SWL-2900U |revision= |upc= |ean= |asin= |price= |est_release_date= |fcc_date=02/01/2008 |manuf_country= |manuf= |manuf_model= |manuf_rev= |if=USB (non-standard connector) |if_bus_version=2.0 |vendor_id= |device_id= |subvendor_id= |subdevice_id= |fcc_id=A3LSWL-2900U |ic_id=649E-SWL2900U |chip1_brand=Broadcom |chip1_model=BCM4326U |chip2_brand= |chip2_model= |chip3_brand= |chip3_model= |flags= |ant_conn= |802dot11_protocols=bg |txchains= |rxchains= |sstreams= |oui= |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} "LEAD-FREE", "SWL-2900U", "REV1.4", and "2007.10.02" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos.
Per the (highly informative) FCC datasheet, the BCM4326U includes.. *an 80MHz ARM7 core *384KB of on-chip SRAM *80KB of on-chip ROM .. and the USB connector is a '''Molex''' 53261-0671 (6 pin, Right Angle, SMT). *(left side of connector) *Pin 1 - Shell (Drain wire, to GND) *Pin 2 - VBUS (RED, 5V from HOST) *Pin 3 - D- (White, USB data Negative) *Pin 4 - D+ (Green, USB data Positive) *Pin 5 - GND (Black, signal ground) *Pin 6 - Shell (Drain wire, to GND) *(right side of connector)
